rationale: Primary pickup set to the minimum allowed by load-avoidance (420 A x 1.2 = 504 A), which also maximizes the minimum-fault sensitivity factor (1800/504 = 3.57 >= 1.5) and minimizes restraint slack. Secondary pickup = 504/100 = 5.04 A, within the 1-10 A device range. Time delay set to the minimum selective value (downstream 0.35 s + selectivity margin 0.30 s = 0.65 s), within the 0-2 s range.
